reading.purpose: Everything the student writes and reads at length; 72ch max.

mono.purpose: Trace data, keys, request ids, the clock.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, popovers, sheets, menus; nothing else casts a shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing. No bounce or elastic.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: State changes: hover, selection, chip fill.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Panel, sheet, dialog, and menu open/close.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion removes every transition and animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action the visitor is there to take; deep teal fill, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0F6E74; color: #FFFFFF; font: 500 13px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #0F6E74 90%, #141A26); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F6E74; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised paper with a control-boundary border and teal text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F6E74; font: 500 13px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(20 26 38 / 0.4); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ECEFF3; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised paper well with a 40 % ink boundary; the border turns teal on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #141A26; font: 400 14px/22px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(20 26 38 / 0.4); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(20 26 38 / 0.7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0F6E74; outline: 2px solid #0F6E74; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only container: raised paper, hairline border, no shadow, never nested.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #FFFFFF; color: #141A26; border: 1px solid #D5DAE2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-title { font: 500 24px/32px 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, serif; margin: 0 0 8px; }

components.name: Draft Label Chip
components.description: Amber wash with ink text and an amber icon; amber is never the text color.
components.css: .ds-chip-draft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #FBF1DC; color: #141A26; border-left: 2px solid #B7791F; font: 500 13px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Stance Chip
components.description: Pill radio chip; selected state fills with the stance wash and colors the border and icon.
components.css: .ds-chip-stance { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 6px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #141A26; border: 1px solid #D5DAE2; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 13px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-stance.is-selected { background: #DDEFF0; border-color: #0F6E74; }

components.name: Rail Item
components.description: 40 px navigation item with a 20 px icon and a visible label; the active item uses the teal wash.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #141A26; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail-item[aria-current='page'] { background: #DDEFF0; color: #0F6E74; }

narrative.overview: Tassl is a simulator-style assessor, and its interface is the panel a pilot reads: calm, high-contrast, and honest about state. Nothing decorates; every mark carries information. Density follows the data: the stance matrix, the clock timeline, and the replay trace are tight and monospaced, while everything the student writes is set in a generous reading measure. The palette is cool paper and tinted ink with one deep-teal voice for action and semantic colors that appear only when they mean something.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground with tinted ink; no pure black or gray.
IBM Plex Serif for headings, Sans for UI and writing, Mono with tabular figures for data.
One accent (deep teal); semantic colors are rare and always redundant with a label or icon.
Hairlines and whitespace instead of elevation; cards never nest.
Motion is 150–200 ms ease-out and removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Wash Rule
rules.body: Text on a soft wash is the matching strong color or ink, never gray.

rules.name: The Amber-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Amber marks draft state as a border, an icon, or a chip fill with ink text; it is never a text color.

rules.name: The Labelled-Stance Rule
rules.body: A stance color never appears without its text label and its icon.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Anything that counts uses Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Student writing surfaces use 16/26 Sans at a 72ch maximum.

rules.name: The One-Layer Rule
rules.body: Cards are never nested inside cards.

dos: Do use the token variables and the Tailwind names that map to them; never a raw hex in a component.
Do keep one accent per screen.
Do pair every stance and semantic color with a text label and an icon.
Do separate sections with whitespace and hairlines; one panel level only.
Do keep motion at 150–200 ms ease-out and remove it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do put numbers in Mono with tabular figures.
donts: Don't use Inter, Arial, or a system default as the primary face.
Don't put gray text on a colored background, or amber text anywhere.
Don't use pure black or pure gray.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't use gradients, illustrations, or raster images.
